com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Add one invoice line with the values you specify. Records a correction; financial changes can reset approval. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes.
examples: Preview adding a line to our fictional practice invoice: description Fictional packing, quantity 2, unit price 12.50, tax amount 0 and total 25.00 in the invoice's currency. Wait for my confirmation.

description: Apply only the exact change returned by preview_add_invoice_line_item, after the user confirms that preview. Accepts its confirmation_token only; changed or expired records require a new preview. Prepare one explicit new invoice line with supplied values. Requires confirmation and records a correction.

confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by this operation’s preview, after the user confirms its displayed changes.
confirmation_token.title: Confirmation Token

name: add_invoice_line_item
title: Add an invoice line
